description: NileBlue is the more casual secondary channel of chemist Nigel Braun (NileRed), where he tackles loosely planned, experimental projects that apply chemistry to everyday objects and food. The videos typically involve ambitious from scratch builds, like making coffee, chocolate, or pop rocks starting from raw materials, or quirky experiments such as creating custom gold grillz or debunking food conspiracies. Unlike the more rigorous main channel, the vibe here is informal, with improvised tools and a focus on fun, often goofy discovery.
